notes.title: Doc Apocalypse by Midian Design is now available!
notes.notes:
Hi there, if you have enjoyed The Apotheosis Project, you may be interested in Doc Apocalypse which was recently released on 22nd December 2017. It's a budget sci-fi point and click adventure.

Doc Apocalypse is an earlier work of Midian Design's (first released in 2012, so before The Apotheosis Project) and a little simpler than The Apotheosis Project, however we have renovated it and given it voices and some other additional features. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/509920/Doc_Apocalypse/

The game is currently available on Steam, and will be available DRM-free from Screen7.uk very soon. We are hoping to fix up translations and try a Linux build in January.

In other news, [b]The Apotheosis Project is 66% off in the Steam winter sale![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/364350/The_Apotheosis_Project/

So if you haven't played any Midian Design games, now is definitely a good time to give them a try! Thanks for playing this game and Doc Apocalypse ːtappeneː
